author: The Infographics Show
description:
Some of the world’s most dangerous killers haven’t been caught, and some may still be hunting right now.
From mass graves in Kenya and unsolved highway murders in the U.S. to chilling cases in Japan, Australia, and beyond, this episode of Every serial killer on the loose today dives into real investigations that were never closed, and the suspects who vanished without a trace.

These aren’t just stories, they’re ongoing mysteries, filled with unanswered questions, missing evidence, and killers who may still be out there.

Because sometimes, the most terrifying part is, that it isn’t over.
